examples.english: It was true that he had not acted with absolute loyalty; the task the old man had given him was one of those that you couldn't even flinch at, because if Dolores decided not to raise her heart or face in a corsair's arms and receive him with palms and olive branches, it didn't seem to him to be something that makes men proud to go and sing to the old man the deference that a woman might deserve.
examples.text: Verdad que él no había obrado con absoluta lealtad; el encargo que habíale dado el viejo era de los de no te menees, porque si a la Dolores le daba por no armar en corso el corazón ni la cara y recibirlo con palmas y olivos, no parecíale a él cosa de las que enorgullecen a los hombres el ir a cantarle al viejo las deferencias que pudiera merecerle a una mujer.
examples.translation: It was true that he had not acted with absolute loyalty; the task the old man had given him was one of those that you couldn't even flinch at, because if Dolores decided not to raise her heart or face in a corsair's arms and receive him with palms and olive branches, it didn't seem to him to be something that makes men proud to go and sing to the old man the deference that a woman might deserve.
